{{Infobox auto}}

'''Grilled melon''' is the simple preparation of the [[Melon|melon slice]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} for 10 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/grilled_melon.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A melon slice cooks into grilled melon in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up a melon slice unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating grilled melon takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Fire Resistance for 0:10.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
